Why Canada has fallen so far behind on public transit

I gave up on pub trans and just got an ebike. Been driving one since 2008 and am never looking back.

http://i.imgur.com/18vg6.gif

Here in Kitchener-Waterloo there was a massive backlash against the LRT that is continuing still. It seems that so many people don't want to look towards to future at all even within a 3-5 year time span.

I mean why invest in transit when your city is growing like this. 2009 -- 2014

K/W resident here! I am impressed with the foresight from our local governance, however...it seems that trying to build the entire downtown LRT strip at the same time is not beneficial. Why not focus one block at a time and concentrate efforts to minimize the negative effects on the downtown core.

I feel the reason for that is that what you are seeing as one project is a bunch. Some of the construction is for upgrading the water pipes, others for laying LRT track, etc.

The workers for one are not the same as the workers for the others. So either you hire the water main guys for 1 week, then send them home for a month, then hire the track people for two weeks, etc.

Instead you just have a phased development. The water guys rip up the roads, then leave it open for the LRT guys to come in.

Yes this is more construction for you, but in the end is cheaper and faster then spinning up all these teams independently.
